responsibility: Declares the common base class and shared interfaces for Rust HIR lowering from parsed AST. The ASTLoweringBase visitor exposes the full AST visitor surface so derived lowerers can override only the node families they translate, and it centralizes access to Analysis::Mappings and builtin attribute metadata together with helper routines for lowering generic parameters, paths, bounds, self parameters, lifetimes, qualifiers, tuple/range patterns, literals, closure parameters, and extern blocks. It also defines the ItemWrapper proxy used to run uniform outer-attribute processing on both HIR items and trait items.
same_name_distinction: Declares the ASTLoweringBase and ItemWrapper interfaces used across the lowering subsystem, while the companion rust-ast-lower-base.cc supplies the concrete default visitor stubs and shared helper implementations.
